title: FreeSpace RTS: Fleet Command
description: Command up to twelve independent fleets from FreeSpace 1, Silent Threat and FreeSpace 2. Choose GTA, PVN, GTVA, the Vasudan Empire, NTF, loyal or rogue GTI, Hammer of Light or Shivans, with faction rosters, command abilities, insignias and unique selectable colors. Build and direct fighters, bombers, escorts and capital ships from an RTS camera, or pilot them with native FSO controls. Includes the FS2 RTS - Escalation campaign. Requires retail FreeSpace 2 assets and upstream FreeSpace Open; MediaVPs are optional.

packages.name: Core
packages.notes: Required RTS scripts, hook tables, the FS2 RTS - Escalation campaign and mission, faction station models, and supporting files.

packages.name: MediaVPs
packages.notes: Optional MVPS 4.7.x dependency for players who want the MediaVP graphics. Not required for the RTS campaign; Knossos downloads MediaVPs separately. Disabled by default.
